description: One performance / attendance penalty parameter of a Rate Card, consumed by the reconciliation engine. The threshold and rule are committed structure; the amount / rate is withheld and seeded out-of-repo, and the rule is gated until the amount is set.

fields.description: Which performance / attendance threshold triggers this penalty.
fields.label: Threshold

fields.description: How the penalty is applied when the threshold fires.
fields.label: Rule

fields.description: The penalty amount / rate. WITHHELD from the committed structure - seeded out-of-repo. Until set, the rule is gated (PENDING-REVIEW); the engine never invents penalty maths.
fields.label: Amount or Rate

fields.description: 1 = this penalty adjusts the client Billable Line.
fields.label: Routes to Billing

fields.description: 1 = this penalty raises a worker Deduction (payroll side). The two checks together express the performance-to-money dual route.
fields.label: Routes to Deduction
